description.en: A forest at night: wind moving through leaves and canopy, with the occasional distant spotted owl.

beds.notes: 120 s from 40 s: seam 0.08x p99.9, -0.3 dB across the wrap, head/tail corr 0.84. The 10 s window looked flatter but contains a close-rustle cluster at master 24-29 s with crest 31 dB, which forced normalisation down to -23.7 LUFS at a -1.5 dBTP ceiling; this window peaks at -17.2 dBFS and reaches -23.0 LUFS with 24.7 dB crest. Even so, the take has close-mic rustle snaps that step 0.3-0.5 of full scale in one sample (-6 dBFS peaks ~24 dB over the bed) and read as crackle: a -12 dBFS transient limiter with a 30 ms release brings the crest down before the final normalise. gainDb -0.7 puts the two-bed mix on the -23.0 LUFS target (the rustle layer alone would push it to -22.3). Raw balance is bright (31% of energy 3-8 kHz, centroid 1997 Hz); treble -4 dB at 4 kHz and +1.5 dB bass at 180 Hz bring the centroid to ~1475 Hz

credit.title: Lot 2 Forest
credit.author: Fission9
credit.modified: trimmed, 150 s loop with 3 s equal-power crossfade, DC removal, 45 Hz high-pass, shelving EQ (treble -4 dB at 4 kHz, bass +1.5 dB at 180 Hz), normalized to -23 LUFS

beds.csvNotes: bright take: treble -4/bass +1.5 EQ and -12 dBFS limiter; 40 s window avoided the 31 dB crest cluster

beds.notes: fills the 300-1000 Hz dip in the Lot 2 Forest take (2.9% of its energy there) and adds close leaf detail; 50 s window at 36 s, seam 0.03x, -0.9 dB across the wrap

credit.author: Cinetony

credit.title: Spotted Owl
credit.author: National Park Service
credit.modified: trimmed to the full four-hoot call (0.25-4.65 s), faded, high-passed at 80 Hz, normalized to -23 LUFS and mixed 9-6 dB under the bed
credit.notes: nps mp3 128 kbps mono, near-full-scale peaks and a -31 dB background between hoots; deliberately kept quiet and rare
